root.label: D.C. judge blocks DOJ voter-list policy

events.label: D.C. judge blocks DOJ voter-list policy

slots.name: policy status
slots.sentence: A federal judge on Friday blocked the Justice Department’s policy of gathering voter registration lists from states, running names through a federal database and telling states to remove suspected noncitizens.

slots.name: challenge status
slots.sentence: Voting rights groups had challenged the effort

slots.name: data quality status
slots.sentence: noting federal data includes errors that have led to citizens being wrongly removed from electoral rolls.
